verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a hosted MCP server that gives AI assistants direct access to project data, letting them query events, funnels, flows, retention and session replays in natural language. A probe independently confirms the MCP docs page exists. For programmatic use, the Query API returns the same calculated results as web-app reports, and JQL supports custom queries. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents answering growth questions via the MCP server or API in practice.
